original.target_description: Study 1: Dettol perceived efficacy, multiple bottles versus single bottle. Accepted full primary paper unavailable; secondary report and publisher search-index excerpt were not substituted for the original paper.

replication.target_description: Replication 2 of original Study 1: MTurk participants rated perceived effectiveness of Dettol after an ad with five bottles versus one bottle; composite of four 9-point items. MTurk participants with >90% approval rating.

n.sample_role: Participants: N explicitly printed for the target comparison in the results figure; analytic N uncertain because exclusion table conflicts.
n.exclusions: Starting N = 838; sequential exclusions for no HIT submission, smartphone, duplicate MTurk ID, duplicate IP address, misreported MTurk ID, unanswered attention check and failed attention check. Exclusions table ends at 571, whereas target results figure prints N = 574. notes: Original acquisition failed; values visible only in publisher search-index excerpts were not treated as an acquired full paper. Replication values are printed primary-author figure values; no conversions or calculations were performed. Sample-count discrepancy retained: results figure N = 574; exclusions table final N = 571. No attempt made to reconcile by calculation or substitution.
